subject: hibiscus
name: 扶桑花
label: 五瓣扶桑花
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One hibiscus front view, five large petals, a single long central stamen ending in a few circles, one leaf.
Complete subject inside the central 76% of the square with 12% clear margins on all four sides. Pure dark contours and open white interiors, no texture, shading or wash. The projecting flower column has only THREE terminal circles, with no tiny stamens or dense seeds.
